programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Go on an air and sea adventure this Vehicle Month! Meekah boards the Intrepid aircraft carrier to see airplanes and helicopters. Then, she has a day of play at Kinderland, using soft shapes to build a huge bridge for her toy train.

programme.title: Meekah
programme.desc: Join Meekah for a bouncy day of sports and play! First, she jumps and plays her way through Sky Zone Trampoline Park. She climbs play structures, goes down slides and even tests her ninja skills in the ninja course! Along the way, she meets some special dino friends! Then, Explorer Meekah searches for shapes and learns about the different balls used in sports. She goes around the indoor playground discovering new ways to bounce, roll and dunk them!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join the fire brigade for Vehicle Month! Blippi visits a fire station in Paris to learn about the life of a firefighter from Captain Cousin. Then, he heads to Kidzania for fire safety training and to put out a fire with a real hose!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Vroom, vroom! Blippi and Meekah are learning all about fire trucks. First, they check out some hi-tech emergency vehicles, learning about their different lights and sirens and how to repair them. The adventure continues as Blippi visits a fire station in Paris, France! There he meets the fire captain, learns some French, tries on a firefighter outfit and explores all the amazing fire trucks. It's a day full of heroic vehicles and fun!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: 3-2-1, Blast off!! Blippi is curious and loves to learn about the world around him so he's excited to share his top ten favorite space and science moments with his friends!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: It's an adventurous kind of day for Blippi as he remembers his top ten favorite moments at Amusement and Water Parks! Join Blippi as he rides on spinning tea cups, goes on roller coasters, slides down water slides and even learns about under water safety.

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Blippi watches along to clips of his top 10 favorite episodes about his love for construction adventures. Countdown with him to number 1!

programme.title: Blippi's Top 10
programme.desc: Time for some indoor fun! Blippi is sharing his top 10 favorite visits to amazing indoor playgrounds. Relive the excitement as he explores giant play structures, jumps in colorful ball pits, and zips down super-fast slides. It's a high-energy collection of his most memorable indoor adventures.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Explore amazing vehicles this Vehicle Month! Help Blippi and Meekah fix the BlippiMobile. See mail delivery, fly a space rocket, visit a construction site, learn about firetrucks, and race a fast Formula 1 car!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on an adventure from dinosaurs to pet knights! He travels back in time with Tabbs to help a little Microraptor prove that being small has its benefits when they rescue a giant sauropod from the mud. Then, they head to the African savannah to learn how to roar, sneak and pounce like a lion! Back at the clubhouse, Blippi learns how to interpret a puppy's tail wags and even travels back in time again to help a real-life knight in shining armor-who happens to be a corgi!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is on adventures big and small, from the mail to outer space! First, Blippi shrinks down to go inside the BlippiMobile's engine to fix a problem. Then, he follows a letter he wrote on its entire journey through the post office to Grandpa Blippi's mailbox! After that, he flies into outer space on a rocket, floating in zero gravity and performing a space walk. He even joins a boulder on its exciting trip down a river to become a grain of sand!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for some technological mayhem with the Oddbods! What's more annoying than Pogo? Another Pogo! He finds Bubbles' cloning machine and decides to make a copy of himself for double the pranks. Then, he uses an invisibility device to cause all sorts of havoc in Oddsville, making his neighbors think they're being haunted by ghosts! Plus, Slick orders a robot buddy, but it malfunctions and causes trouble.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Get ready for a wild ride of random antiks with Joey and Boo! The adventure begins when they take a leaf for a boat ride but get chased by a hungry fish. Then, they struggle to move a giant piece of candy until they eat some of it, giving them super speed! The random fun continues as Boo falls into a pot of invisible ink, they find a house made of gingerbread that a spider also wants and they discover a tiny toy racecar that takes them on a wild ride they can't control!

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join Joey and Boo in a series of adventures where everything goes wrong! First, Joey plans the perfect birthday party for Boo, only to forget her present at the last minute! Then, when Boo gets sick, Joey must go on an arduous journey for soup ingredients. The bad luck continues as Joey gets stuck to the back of a spider, they get encased in cement while chasing a berry and they are accidentally rolled up inside a meatball by a dung beetle!

programme.title: Insectibles
programme.desc: The Insectibles are locked in a desperate race against Adilla and her roaches to secure a dangerous Shrinkinator lens before its destructive power can be unleashed on the yard. programme.desc: Join Blippi for Vehicle Month and discover amazing trucks! Learn about monster trucks with Megan, see why flies love garbage trucks, explore an ice cream truck with Sherry Pop, and see how Kareem the Crane builds a skyscraper.

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Explore amazing vehicles this Vehicle Month! Help Blippi and Meekah fix the BlippiMobile. See mail delivery, fly a space rocket, visit a construction site, learn about firetrucks, and race a fast Formula 1 car!

programme.title: Blippi Wonders
programme.desc: Blippi is answering some of life's biggest questions! He shrinks down for a night adventure in a mouth to learn the right way to brush teeth from Bill Brushy. Then, he flies up a nose to find out what makes us sneeze! His curiosity continues as he learns how a fly can walk upside down on the ceiling, discovers the artistic process of how spiders make their webs and even becomes a contestant on a game show to learn the difference between fruits and vegetables!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: The Oddbods are dealing with some big changes! Pogo tries his new hypnosis machine on Jeff, who scoffs at it. But it's not long before Pogo gets Jeff to behave like a dog! Then, Zee and Jeff are forced to live together when Jeff calls fumigators on Zee's house. How long can this alliance of opposites last? Plus, when Newt goes on holiday, Zee is enlisted to house-sit and look after her beloved pet hamster!

programme.title: Oddbods
programme.desc: Get ready for some hilarious mishaps with the Oddbods! Slick finds himself in a tricky spot when he accidentally asks both Bubbles and Newt out on a date for the same night! How long can he keep them from discovering each other? Then, when Fuse injures himself, Newt feels obliged to be his nurse. Unfortunately, her nursing skills only seem to make his injuries worse!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The Park Rangers are trying out some awesome new dino gadgets! First, Park Rangers LB and Aaron must escape a giant T-Rex! Armed with their new science inventions-an invisible cloak and a hologram projector-they cleverly outsmart the T-Rex and make a daring getaway. Then, Park Ranger Darren shows off his new awesome gadget, the Dino Translator! Join the park rangers as they go on an adventure to test out their new tool!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: The Park Rangers are on the case in the ultimate dino detective mystery! Park Ranger Tara is close to completing her dino guidebook but needs a scan of a T-Rex to finish it. Then, Park Rangers Asher and Darren discover mysterious dino footprints in the ground and decide to follow the trail on an exciting adventure. Finally, Park Ranger Zoe discovers a theory about a Flying T-Rex, and the rangers set out to prove if this incredible dinosaur truly exists!

programme.title: T-Rex Ranch
programme.desc: Join the Park Rangers for a super silly day of ranger fails! First, Park Ranger Darren accidentally gets his night vision goggles stuck on his head, leaving him unable to see properly. Park Ranger Asher has to step up to be Darren's eyes and ears to guide him! Then, in another silly mishap, Darren accidentally gets hit with a sleepy dart! Can Park Rangers Asher and Naomi find the ingredients for the Wake Up Juice in time?

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Spring has sprung, and so have the Antiks! Join them as they explore a world of blossoming flowers and fresh spring treats. From climbing giant mushrooms to navigating through a garden of delights, their adventures are as colorful as the season. It's a story about discovery, teamwork, and enjoying the sweet tastes of spring.

programme.title: Antiks
programme.desc: Join Joey and Boo as they get caught in bizarre traps and make crazy escapes! The trouble starts when a plant's magical aroma draws them inside, but then they can't get back out. On another adventure, they run towards a tasty berry but don't realize their path is blocked by quicksand! From getting spooked by a bug zapper to having an uninvited guest with a huge appetite move into their home, Joey and Boo must always find a clever way to escape!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Get ready for a sandy, speedy Vehicle Month! Join Blippi as he learns to ride ATVs, UTVs, and Dune Buggies over giant sand hills. Then, buckle up for a test drive of the awesome, brand new, custom-made Blippi-Mobile!

programme.title: Blippi
programme.desc: Join Blippi and Meekah as they get curious about science! They embark on an environmental science scavenger hunt through the Explorit Museum, learning about pollination, wind and solar power. Their curiosity continues as they build and test their own cars to see how fast they can go, even constructing a big city for their vehicles to drive in!

programme.title: A Writer's Odyssey II
programme.desc: Fallen novelist Lu Kong Wen is drawn into his own fictional world, where a villain seeks to invade reality, sparking a cross-dimensional clash that will change both worlds.

programme.title: Tales from the Occult: Body and Soul
programme.desc: This horror anthology series returns featuring three spooky crime stories about an ex-hair model, a cat lover and the love triangle between a dental nurse, a dentist, and a chef.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well Too
programme.desc: Another super comedy directed by Clifton Ko about more farcical couplings, mistaken identities, infidelities, and arranged marriages set in the Sung Dynasty.

programme.title: Wolf Pack
programme.desc: Specializing in overseas security jobs, The Wolf Pack discovers that terrorists are planning to destroy the country's energy source. Lead by Lao Diao, the pack must move out to stop them!

programme.title: Under Current
programme.desc: The death of a charity's CFO and a missing donation force lawyer Ma into an alliance with a police officer. Together, they risk everything to uncover the charity's darkest secrets and seek justice.

programme.title: Last Song For You
programme.desc: Musician Su reunites with his first love Xia, in a hospital during their darkest hours. Seeing his inner struggle, the ailing Xia sends Su on a final journey—her parting gift to reignite his life.

programme.title: God of Gambler's Return
programme.desc: A Taiwanese crime boss wants to become the new God of Gamblers, so he kills Gao Jin's pregnant wife. Gao Jin is indignant and vows to fight the crime boss to avenge his wife's death.

programme.title: The Last Dance
programme.desc: Debt-ridden wedding planner, Sheng, finds a lifeline as he transitions into a funeral planner. Inspired by the respected Master Wen, Sheng gradually changes his attitude towards his career and life.

programme.title: Cloudy Mountain
programme.desc: As a decade-long tunnel project reaches completion, an earthquake strikes, forcing a retired soldier & his son to stop the disasters at the source, or risk the community - and the tunnel.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: A mother in her 50s unexpectedly becomes pregnant, turning her family's quiet life upside down. As they prepare for the baby's arrival, chaos and laughter follow, teaching them love and acceptance.

programme.title: New Police Story
programme.desc: A sozzled police inspector (Jackie Chan) must pull himself up again after a bungled mission causes his entire team to be wiped out.

programme.title: Pass And Goal
programme.desc: After losing everything, a businesswoman starts over in Sham Shui Po, forming a kids' football team to face an elite squad. She chooses to rewrite their first half with her second.

programme.title: The Invisible Guest
programme.desc: Joanna is a suspect of a locked-room murder where her lover is found dead. When the police investigates the case, they discover another murder case which leads them to the truth.

programme.title: Love Is The Only Answer
programme.desc: When a flash of her groom's infidelity is revealed at their wedding, Bo cancels the entire affair. However, within a year, he comes knocking on her door again.

programme.title: Detective Dee and Nine-storey Demon Buil
programme.desc: Detective Dee investigates a series of strange incidents at Tang's building, finding the master suspicious when even his eldest daughter secretly tells Dee of his odd behavior.

programme.title: All's Well End's Well (Extended version)
programme.desc: In this Hong Kong comedy, three Chang brothers learn love needs care, not haste or selfishness. This extended cut adds a shootout scene missing from the 2016 Lunar New Year release

programme.title: 77 Heartwarmings
programme.desc: After breaking up with Adam, Eva focuses on her career, but Adam is determined to win her back and makes 77 attempts to do so. The situation worsens when a Thai movie idol courts Eva

programme.title: She's Got No Name
programme.desc: In 1945 Shanghai, a gruesome murder shocks "Jiang Yuan Nong" when the frail Zhan Zhou Shi kills and dismembers her husband. As dark truths emerge, the fate of everyone involved begins to twist.

programme.title: Bounty Hunters
programme.desc: Five bounty hunters are tasked to track down the culprit of a series of bombings plaguing a hotel group in Bangkok. Can they solve the crime and finally collect the bounty?

programme.title: Stand Up Story
programme.desc: Mancer cares for his intellectually challenged father Wah. When Mancer finds solace in stand-up comedy, he turns his life's hardships into comedic gold, from school ridicule to pandemic woes.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: Celebrating the 25th anniversary of HK's Handover with an anthology of 4 stories about an autistic young man, a reconciliation, a Chinese opera star & a Nepali youth.

programme.title: Crisis Negotiators
programme.desc: Negotiator Wai is framed for murder. He takes hostages at the police station and demands talk with a former negotiator. As they engage in a tense battle of wits, their perspectives gradually shift.

programme.title: As It Burns
programme.desc: Detective Wei investigates a fatal explosion involving two women who look alike. As he delves deeper, Wei unveils a web of deceit as details from the past and present come together in unexpected ways.

programme.title: Wu Kong
programme.desc: Eddie Peng charms as possibly the most handsome Monkey King alongside Shawn Yue & Ni Ni in this fantasy-action-adventure film.

programme.title: Legend of the Fist:The Return of Chen Zhen
programme.desc: As Japan's grip on China tightens, Chen Zhen returns to Shanghai to infiltrate the notorious Club Casablanca, whose owner is a Japanese collaborator.
